item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
A US-brokered ceasefire now covers Oleshky and has been extended across the Kherson region, while local ceasefires operate in other frontline cities. Putin has been courting African leaders as Moscow seeks to expand its footprint in Africa, and he held rare phone calls with the leaders of Norway and Finland. Trump is exploring lifting sanctions on a Russian flagship investment fund, and Zelenskyy urged faster delivery of Patriot missiles while pushing back against Musk, who was praised by Putin as a "genius" for his Starshield system. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli forces have intensified a crackdown in Hebron, displacing thousands and prompting a UN warning of ethnic cleansing, while IDF raids have killed several Hamas operatives and commanders in Gaza. The parliamentary election remains deadlocked, with no clear winner and exit polls showing a narrow edge for the opposition amid record turnout. Gaza’s women filmmakers have launched a new academy to turn pain into cinema, and a Hebron groom was caught in a military lockdown. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Iran and the regional confrontation: the situation
item.description:
Iran is urging the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz while Houthi missiles and drones continue striking Saudi oil facilities and airports, prompting the reopening of Riyadh Airport after weeks of disruption. The United States is weighing renewed strikes on Iran, pushing oil prices above $117 a barrel, and has lost roughly 25% of its Reaper drones as the war depletes its arsenal. Iran's supreme leader and top security chief discussed war and Hormuz, and the IAEA called for nuclear inspections after reporting no evidence of repairs to US-bombed sites. The war costs are estimated at $47 billion, according to U.S. military estimates, and 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

Families of civilians killed in the attacks have held funerals. The conflict produced 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

Somalia denied that Turkish F‑16 aircraft struck its own positions during the clashes. The conflict produced 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
